data.one_liner: A simple responsive design approach for Flutter apps supporting scaling sizing and fonts.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of extension methods (.h, .w, .sp, .r, etc.) on numbers to build responsive layouts and scale fonts based on a design resolution. Requires wrapping your app in a Resize widget.
use_when: You want to scale dimensions and font sizes proportionally based on a target design resolution.
You need a lightweight solution for responsive sizing using extension methods.
avoid_when: You prefer built-in Flutter adaptive mechanisms like LayoutBuilder or MediaQuery without pixel-scaling extensions.
You need more advanced multi-breakpoint adaptive layout structures.
strengths: Easy to use with numeric extensions like .h, .w, and .sp.
Supports custom base design sizes and REM-based font sizing.
weaknesses: Relies on global initialization via a Resize widget in the widget tree.
Hardcoded scaling approach may not fit every screen aspect ratio equally well.
data.setup_notes: Initialize the Resize helper widget in your main app builder before using any responsive extensions.

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides robust responsive scaling, breakpoints, and auto-scaling for various screen sizes.

alternatives.name: sizer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative sizing extension package based on device width and height percentages.

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers layout builders to target specific device types like mobile, tablet, and desktop.
